meta.description: Statsify is the largest Hypixel Discord bot for viewing your Hypixel Network stats, leaderboards, sessions, and more.

footer.affiliation: Statsify is not affiliated with or endorsed by Hypixel Inc. or Mojang.
footer.mojang: Not an official Minecraft service. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.

search.label: Search players
search.heading: Search Your Hypixel Stats
search.noResults: No players match "{{query}}". Check the spelling, or look them up on Hypixel.

player.noGames: {{name}} has no game stats yet. Press Update stats after they've played a game.
player.refreshLimited: Too many updates right now, try again shortly.
player.refreshFailed: Couldn't update. Try again in a minute.
player.refreshError: Couldn't refresh. Try again in a moment.

signature.title: Get signature
signature.description: Paste one of these into your Hypixel Forums signature, or anywhere else that shows images. The image carries the stats from the last refresh on this page, with the time they were fetched printed on it.
signature.card: Full card URL (808×540, too tall for a forum signature)

notFound.title: Player Not Found
notFound.description: We haven't seen {{name}} yet. Check the spelling, or ask Hypixel to look them up.
notFound.unknown: Hypixel doesn't know a player called {{name}} either. Check the spelling, or they may never have joined Hypixel.
notFound.verify: The verification didn't go through. Complete it, then try again.
notFound.verifyFailed: The verification didn't load. Allow challenges.cloudflare.com, then reload the page.
notFound.limited: Too many lookups right now, try again in {{time}}.
notFound.unavailable: Hypixel didn't answer. Try again in a minute.
notFound.error: The lookup didn't go through. Try again in a moment.

leaderboards.title: Leaderboards
leaderboards.noMatches: No leaderboards match "{{query}}". Try fewer words, or a game or stat name.
leaderboards.listFailed: Couldn't load the list. Click the box to try again.
leaderboards.find: Find a player on this leaderboard
leaderboards.unknown: We haven't seen {{name}} yet. Check the spelling, or open their player page to look them up.
leaderboards.unranked: {{name}} isn't on this leaderboard yet: it only ranks values above 0. Refresh their player page after they've played.
leaderboards.moved: {{name}}'s rank changed while the page loaded, so they're not on it. Try again to find them.
leaderboards.empty: Nobody's on this leaderboard yet. Players join it once someone looks them up on Statsify.
leaderboards.aboutHighest: Ranks players looked up on Statsify with a non-zero value, highest first. Values are from each player's last lookup.
leaderboards.aboutLowest: Ranks players looked up on Statsify with a non-zero value, lowest first. Values are from each player's last lookup.

game.neverPlayed: {{name}} has no {{game}} stats yet, so everything here is 0. Pick another game, or press Refresh after they've played.
game.noMatches: No stats match "{{query}}". Try fewer letters, or clear the box.
game.hint: Select any stat to see its leaderboard around {{name}}.

mostPlayed.winsLosses: Most played, by wins and losses

notFound.title: OOPS!
notFound.description: This page doesn't exist. Check the address, or go back home.

error.title: Something Went Wrong
error.description: Statsify couldn't load this page. Try again in a moment.
